newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rupiah stable, swaps down in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rupiah stable, swaps down in late trade.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah was stable against the dollar in moderate late trading on Monday, with swap rates falling across the board, dealers said.
They said the spot rate was little changed and was trapped in narrow-range trading between 2,347.0/48.0 during the day.
Spot rupiah was quoted at 2,347.40/47.90 at 0900 GMT, compared with an opening of 2,347.00/48.00.
Dealers said operators were seen offloading longer-term swap premiums following a narrowing of dollar and rupiah interest rates in the interbank market.

One major local bank dealer said operators were seen unloading longer-term swaps as tight dollar liquidity in the money market caused interest rates to rise and reduce the attraction of the rupiah in the short-term.
"This seemed to have triggered some offloading. The trend was already seen since last week as the dollar market tended to be tight," the dealer said.
He said it was not clear if it had any link to possible attempts by authorities to lift the dollar from the floor rate of the central bank by draining dollar liquidity.
Overnight dollar deposits were traded at 6.0/6.25 percent after hitting a high of seven percent in the morning.
"Since the interest rate differentials are narrowing, players might consider going long on dollars rather than short," the dealer said.
He said the dollar-rupiah rate was expected to range between 2,347.0 and 2,349.0 on Tuesday.
"The underlying tone appears to be bullish on dollars in the short-term," the local bank dealer said.
Tomorrow and today rupiah closed at 2,347.00/47.35 and 2,347.25/47.50, respectively.
Both overnight and tom/next swap were at par/0.2 points.
Dealers said ample rupiah liquidity in the money market seemed to have helped dollar buying.
One-month swap fell to 14.0/15.0 from 16.1/16.5, twoto 31.25/32.25 from 34.0/35.5, three to 48.0/48.5 from 51.5/52.5 and six to 98.0/99.0 from 103.0/104.0 points.
The central bank raised its intervention rate by one point to 2,344.0/2,462.0 and the conversion rate also by one point to 2,344.0/2,390.0 on Monday -- Jakarta newsroom +6221 384-6364.
